history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A male anime character in a white and black traditional Japanese outfit, resembling a shihakusho from Bleach, is shown from multiple angles against a plain white background. He has short brown hair, wears glasses, and has a friendly smile. His outfit consists of a black inner garment, a white haori (outer robe) with black trim and a distinctive pattern of black, elongated oval shapes with smaller dots inside along the hem, and wide black hakama pants. A light gray obi (sash) is tied around his waist. He is holding a katana with a dark green hilt and a dark blade, in various poses: some showing him holding the sword in front of him, others with the sword at his side or behind him. The lighting is bright and even, creating a clean, studio-like atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by white, black, and gray, with the green of the sword hilt providing a subtle accent. The overall mood is confident and approachable, with a clear nod to anime aesthetics. The rendering style is highly realistic, almost photorealistic, with detailed textures on the fabric and the character's features.
